title: Battle of Hallue
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hallue", at revision 1370442487, opens: "The Battle of Hallue was a battle of the Franco-Prussian War on 23 and 24 December 1870." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q550305, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1870 battle of the Franco-Prussian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
